{"variables":{"shopId":278,"storeId":null,"page":1,"pageSize":20},"query":"query ($shopId: Int!, $storeId: String, $page: Int, $pageSize: Int) {
  popularHybridProducts(
    shopId: $shopId
    storeId: $storeId
    page: $page
    pageSize: $pageSize
  ) {
    contents {
      ... on Product {
        ...ProductFragmentForThumbnail
        __typename
      }
      ... on ComparisonProduct {
        ...ComparisonProductFragment
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    pageInfo {
      totalCount
      totalPages
      currentPage
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment ProductFragmentForThumbnail on Product {
  id
  shopProductId
  promoteProductId
  name
  imageUrl
  url
  outlinkUrl
  productPageUrl
  discount
  price
  specialPrice
  point {
    amount
    bonusAmountForApp
    calculatedAmount
    limit
    __typename
  }
  calculatedPoint
  status
  merchant {
    name
    shopId
    storeId
    merchantId
    imageUrl
    displayPoints
    url
    point {
      amount
      bonusAmountForApp
      calculatedAmount
      __typename
    }
    showPointAmount
    showEstimatedPoint
    vendorTypes
    ownedTraffic
    __typename
  }
  productReward {
    endTime
    startTime
    rewardPoint
    limit
    __typename
  }
  rewardCountdownEndTime
  lowPriceType
  priceDifference
  productType
  hideEstimatedPoint
  __typename
}

fragment ComparisonProductFragment on ComparisonProduct {
  id
  comparisonId
  name
  url
  imageUrl
  minPrice
  maxPrice
  lowPriceType
  minPoint
  maxPoint
  calculatedMinPoint
  calculatedMaxPoint
  totalProduct
  __typename
}"}

{"variables":{"shopId":278,"storeId":null,"page":2,"pageSize":20},"query":"query ($shopId: Int!, $storeId: String, $page: Int, $pageSize: Int) {
  popularHybridProducts(
    shopId: $shopId
    storeId: $storeId
    page: $page
    pageSize: $pageSize
  ) {
    contents {
      ... on Product {
        ...ProductFragmentForThumbnail
        __typename
      }
      ... on ComparisonProduct {
        ...ComparisonProductFragment
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    pageInfo {
      totalCount
      totalPages
      currentPage
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment ProductFragmentForThumbnail on Product {
  id
  shopProductId
  promoteProductId
  name
  imageUrl
  url
  outlinkUrl
  productPageUrl
  discount
  price
  specialPrice
  point {
    amount
    bonusAmountForApp
    calculatedAmount
    limit
    __typename
  }
  calculatedPoint
  status
  merchant {
    name
    shopId
    storeId
    merchantId
    imageUrl
    displayPoints
    url
    point {
      amount
      bonusAmountForApp
      calculatedAmount
      __typename
    }
    showPointAmount
    showEstimatedPoint
    vendorTypes
    ownedTraffic
    __typename
  }
  productReward {
    endTime
    startTime
    rewardPoint
    limit
    __typename
  }
  rewardCountdownEndTime
  lowPriceType
  priceDifference
  productType
  hideEstimatedPoint
  __typename
}

fragment ComparisonProductFragment on ComparisonProduct {
  id
  comparisonId
  name
  url
  imageUrl
  minPrice
  maxPrice
  lowPriceType
  minPoint
  maxPoint
  calculatedMinPoint
  calculatedMaxPoint
  totalProduct
  __typename
}"}

{"variables":{"shopId":278,"storeId":null,"page":3,"pageSize":20},"query":"query ($shopId: Int!, $storeId: String, $page: Int, $pageSize: Int) {
  popularHybridProducts(
    shopId: $shopId
    storeId: $storeId
    page: $page
    pageSize: $pageSize
  ) {
    contents {
      ... on Product {
        ...ProductFragmentForThumbnail
        __typename
      }
      ... on ComparisonProduct {
        ...ComparisonProductFragment
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    pageInfo {
      totalCount
      totalPages
      currentPage
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment ProductFragmentForThumbnail on Product {
  id
  shopProductId
  promoteProductId
  name
  imageUrl
  url
  outlinkUrl
  productPageUrl
  discount
  price
  specialPrice
  point {
    amount
    bonusAmountForApp
    calculatedAmount
    limit
    __typename
  }
  calculatedPoint
  status
  merchant {
    name
    shopId
    storeId
    merchantId
    imageUrl
    displayPoints
    url
    point {
      amount
      bonusAmountForApp
      calculatedAmount
      __typename
    }
    showPointAmount
    showEstimatedPoint
    vendorTypes
    ownedTraffic
    __typename
  }
  productReward {
    endTime
    startTime
    rewardPoint
    limit
    __typename
  }
  rewardCountdownEndTime
  lowPriceType
  priceDifference
  productType
  hideEstimatedPoint
  __typename
}

fragment ComparisonProductFragment on ComparisonProduct {
  id
  comparisonId
  name
  url
  imageUrl
  minPrice
  maxPrice
  lowPriceType
  minPoint
  maxPoint
  calculatedMinPoint
  calculatedMaxPoint
  totalProduct
  __typename
}"}
